recognize_zh: 低倍視野中，新生兒周邊血內可見多顆深藍色、細胞質少的胚芽球，並有核濃縮的有核紅血球與偏藍的多染性紅血球（polychromasia），在 Down 症候群背景下即符合 TAM。
features: Increased circulating blasts (about ten in one low-power field) of small to intermediate size with high N:C ratio
Blasts with scant basophilic cytoplasm, some with irregular outlines or cytoplasmic projections and occasional vacuoles
Nucleated red blood cell with a small dense, round pyknotic nucleus
Crowded red cell background typical of neonatal high hematocrit
describe_en: Low-power view of a neonatal peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased number of circulating blasts with high N:C ratios, basophilic cytoplasm and irregular cell borders, some with cytoplasmic projections suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. A nucleated red blood cell and scattered polychromatic red cells are present in a crowded red cell background. Detailed chromatin and nucleolar features are not resolvable at this magnification. In a neonate with trisomy 21 and a GATA1 mutation, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS)
ddx.vs: ML-DS arises later in infancy or early childhood after a TAM or de novo, often with preceding cytopenias and dysplasia, whereas TAM presents within days of birth; morphology overlaps.
Stressed neonates show nucleated red cells and left-shifted granulocytes but not a population of blasts with megakaryoblastic cytoplasmic blebs.
Congenital AML or ALL in infants without trisomy 21 often has KMT2A rearrangement or other fusions and does not resolve spontaneously.
Mature lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm, whereas blasts have finer chromatin, larger size and irregular basophilic cytoplasm.
